feature: Default-off CLI option performs one additional structured repair only when the existing answer validator still reports errors; the new response is accepted only if all validation errors are cleared.
adapter_commit: 0e98f6c feat: add opt-in extra answer audit repair
design_commit: 8aa8653 docs: plan bounded answer audit repair
retrieval_source: Stage302 saved per-question retrieval lists; no reranker calls and no search reordering. Top-20 order is identical to Stage302.
decision: Keep the extra repair opt-in. A direct frozen-answer pilot fully repaired 6/29 invalid audits with no judge-label change. In the fresh full run, 24 extra repairs were attempted and three were accepted; none changed a judge label. Invalid audits fell from 29 to 21, but the full score was 444/500, six below Stage302. Broad answer variation (232 changed answers) prevents attributing the score delta to the repair.
limitations: Stage306 does not meet the 97% gate; the best observed full score remains Stage299 at 461/500, 24 below 485. Structural audit validity is not factual memory precision. Memory precision remains unmeasured, live offsite disaster recovery is unverified, and Stage166 was not run.
